individual_findings: Individually reviewed the exact Countdown copy and all legacy controls/presets. Corrected unique block identity/schema/name and added an optional explicit start date/time, native elapsed-time progress and its label/height controls. A valid start earlier than the end enables bounded zero-to-100 time progress using the existing Countdown clock; original saved end-date countdown remains available without a start. No inventory/sales progress inferred. Preserved all old setting IDs, replaced invented dates/claims with neutral setup states and accurate time-progress preset names.

individual_findings: Individually reviewed static/product-composed/random message controls and all three presets. Removed fabricated purchase/viewer/location/popularity defaults and encoded Unicode literals from new insertion state; schema clearly describes merchant text without any live feed. Saved configured messages and random selection remain. Escaped JSON data attribute replaces executable inline script injection risk; real initial message survives no-JS/parse failure and blank entries are filtered. Empty editor guidance, icon-disabled single-column layout, bounded content and finite pulse animation repaired.

individual_findings: Individually reviewed all providers/native/copy/status/style controls and presets. Uses actual native product URL plus request origin for locale/market paths, escaped attributes and meaningful native share text. Progressive buttons require capability; native provider/email links and a labeled readonly copy field work without JS. Clipboard promise or positive legacy copy result alone yields success; errors/cancel/pending async disposal are honest and scoped. Focus restoration, named groups/default labels, accessible status when visually disabled, visible Buttons versus Icons style and bounded wrapping repaired.
